statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate syncopal events with underlying rhythm disturbances
The procedure code billed is CPT 93247
The diagnosis codes submitted are R55 and Z86.73
The claim was denied based on coordination of benefits rules (reason code CO-22)
